title: It's a disgrace: Chelsea 1–1 Barcelona, Champions League semi-final (6 May 2009)
post:
Chelsea 1–1 Barcelona, 6 May 2009. Four penalty appeals turned down, a 93rd-minute equaliser with Barcelona's first shot on target, and Didier Drogba shouting into a live TV camera. The referee, Tom Henning Øvrebø, later said it was not his best day.

#chelsea #barcelona #drogba #iniesta #championsleague #ucl #football #footballstory #footballtiktok

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"; a tense, clipped read: every appeal ends on the same flat word

phrases.text: Live on TV, Didier Drogba screams into a camera: It's a disgrace! This is why.
phrases.say: [intense] Live on TV, Didier Drogba screams into a camera: It's a disgrace! ... This is why.

phrases.text: May 2009. A Champions League semi-final: Chelsea against Barcelona. After 9 minutes, Essien volleys Chelsea in front.
phrases.say: May two thousand and nine. A Champions League semi-final: Chelsea, against Barcelona. After nine minutes, Essien volleys Chelsea in front.

phrases.text: Minute 23. Malouda goes down under Alves on the edge of the box. The referee, Tom Henning Øvrebø, gives a free kick. Outside.
phrases.say: [intense] Minute twenty-three. Malouda goes down under Alves, on the edge of the box. The referee, Tom Henning Ovrebo, gives a free kick... Outside.

phrases.text: Three minutes later, Abidal pulls Drogba back inside it. Nothing.
phrases.say: Three minutes later, Abidal pulls Drogba back, inside it. Nothing.

phrases.text: In the second half Abidal is sent off. Barcelona have ten men.
phrases.say: In the second half, Abidal is sent off. Barcelona have ten men.

phrases.text: Then the ball hits Piqué's hand in the box. Nothing.
phrases.say: Then the ball hits Piqué's hand, in the box. Nothing.

phrases.text: Minute 93. Barcelona's first shot on target. Iniesta. 1–1, and Barcelona go through on away goals.
phrases.say: [building] Minute ninety-three. Barcelona's first shot on target... [awed] Iniesta! One–one. And Barcelona go through, on away goals.

phrases.text: One last chance: Ballack's shot hits Eto'o's arm. Nothing. Four appeals. No penalty.
phrases.say: One last chance: Ballack's shot hits Eto's arm. Nothing. Four appeals... no penalty.

phrases.text: At the final whistle, Drogba, already substituted, marches back on in flip-flops, and finds a camera.
phrases.say: At the final whistle, Drogba, already substituted, marches back on, in flip-flops... and finds a camera.

phrases.text: It cost him a three-match ban. The referee changed hotels that night, and got death threats for years.
phrases.say: It cost him a three-match ban. The referee changed hotels that night, and got death threats for years.

phrases.text: Nine years later he said: It was not my best day.
phrases.say: [quietly] Nine years later, he said: it was not my best day.
